about: The company makes much of a tame creature: by species, and whether it has been made much of before (moment: first, again).

lines.text: You crouch and hold out a hand. {Actor} sniffs it carefully, then leans {their} whole weight against your knee while you scratch behind {their} ears.
{Actor} rolls over at once and shows you {their} belly. It is not a dignified dog.
{Actor} leans into your hand, eyes half shut.
{Actor}'s tail goes round like a cartwheel.
{Actor} puts {their} chin on your knee and sighs, as if this were all {they} had ever wanted.
{Actor} allows it, for a moment, then walks away with {their} tail up.
{Actor} pushes {their} head hard against your hand and purrs like a kettle.
You run a hand down {actor}'s neck. It is warm, and {they} [shift|shifts] {their} weight and [let|lets] you.
{Actor} tolerates it, and then tries to eat your sleeve.
Your hand sinks into {actor}'s fleece up to the wrist. It is greasy, and warm, and smells of hill.
{Actor} grunts with deep approval while you scratch {their} back with a stick.
